description: the 2-cube's three edges at the corner (2, 2, 2) filleted in one call at r 0.2: the sphere corner, an octant of the ball centred (2 - r, 2 - r, 2 - r), tangent to the three blend cylinders along great circles, one of them its equator and two its meridians, which meet at its pole (2 - r, 2 - r, 2) on the cap, where the cap's two contacts cross; no corner edge is cut; each edge loses (1 - pi/4) r^2 along 2 - r and the corner cube r^3 (1 - pi/6)
